HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness. ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness. .
   D. Apply the teaching of Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Social and National Festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social and National Festivals.
   B. Say Social and National Festivals has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Social and National Festivals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Social and National Festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s.
   B. Use Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8.? (1 mark)
   A. Use Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8. has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8..

7. Which response best shows understanding of Aspects of integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of integrity has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Aspects of integrity.
   C. Apply the teaching of Aspects of integrity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Aspects of integrity to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str? (1 mark)
   A. Use Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Dainik Prarthana? (1 mark)
   A. Say Dainik Prarthana has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dainik Prarthana.
   C. Apply the teaching of Dainik Prarthana with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Dainik Prarthana to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   B. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Panch- mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Use Panch- mahabhoot to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Panch- mahabhoot with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Panch- mahabhoot has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Panch- mahabhoot.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
